title: Structure theory of $BV$ functions and finite perimeter sets on Riemannian manifolds
summary: We develop the theory of functions of bounded variation and the structure theory of finite-perimeter sets on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds without relying on global curvature bounds or completeness of the manifold. To this end, we build a localization framework that permits a synthesis of techniques from Euclidean geometric measure theory and analysis on metric measure spaces while preserving genuinely Riemannian features, such as polar and normal vector fields, reduced boundaries, and approximate tangent spaces.
